2. Discussion on the Annual Estimate of Revenue and Expenditure begins.
Honorable Finance Minister Dr. Swarnim Wagle will present the proposal 'Let the general discussion on the Annual Estimate of Revenue and Expenditure for the fiscal year 2083/084 begin' with a statement.
3. General discussion on the Annual Estimate of Revenue and Expenditure for the fiscal year 2083/084 will begin.
